name: Post Time Studio
format: vertical animated story-fact explainer Short (55-70 s, 1080x1920, 30 fps): a laughed-at fix that physics proves right
descriptionFooter: Original animated explainer: a real fact told as a story.
disclosure: Narration, sound effects and music were made with AI (ElevenLabs).
coverStyle: the film's own hook frame (first 3 seconds), the key object readable, no text, no ring, no vignette, engine depth of field (studio2/library/cover-dof.mjs)
visualFlavour: each film takes its own world and palette from its topic (village by day, night and day for square-wheel); bright, readable, one carrier object
soundFlavour: light playful score about 10-14 dB under the voice, a sound for every contact, silence before the payoff
contentRules: One thesis, at most 2 facts, one carrier object that stays on screen and changes.
Fiction is labelled as fiction; real facts carry their sources in SCRIPT.md.
Titles: concrete object plus hidden reason, never how X works or the science of.
